invalid_tangent_policy: Do not invent a tangent or restart an expired particle; Root owns emission selection.
clock: Root supplies presentation age. Particle/core sampling continues during NPC hitstop.
freshness: Stateless sampling at true age, no pending-contact replay queue. Root handles current event budgets/priority.

material_selection.wet: confirmed wet clothing contact, excluding bare head

current_runtime_gap: CombatImpact has point/normal but no tangent. Root must preserve the actual contact's sweep tangent when producing or consuming the event.
offline_preview: Example contact basis is labelled and is not a real game input or SDK runtime capture.
anchor: Root offsets the actual contact point once: anchor=point+0.008*N. Particle p0 does not include that shared offset.
reference_function_point: contact_motion.sample_particle point argument is the already-offset Stage anchor.

ground.constraint: base height along real ground normal is at least zero relative to the already-offset anchor
ground.orientation: fixed TBN; local +Z remains the surface normal
ground.landing_trigger: Root-resolved actual fall/body-ground contact, synchronized to fall presentation clock
ground.no_guessed_trigger: UI dodge feedback and fixed DEAD elapsed are not physical ground contacts
